chain: VisualWorkerRuntime._initialize_local stores _local_original and calls _register_local_original before initialize_visual_bootstrap_if_absent.
Registration checks genuine initialization caller, owner live app and exact original description, then stores owner->runtime. Registration does not require adoption.
bind_step_grounding scans tuple(_LOCAL_RUNTIMES.values()) and eagerly calls runtime.original.digest on every entry.
VisualWorkerRuntime.original first calls supervision_source_publication, whose absence raises RuntimeError.

A distinct registered unadopted runtime is therefore reachable in the scan and can abort otherwise valid target grounding. The scan can also read another owner/thread source before selecting the intended owner.
available_safe_description_index: _LOCAL_ORIGINALS[owner] is an existing sealed canonical JSON string recorded at bootstrap and removed with _LOCAL_RUNTIMES by _revoke_worker; comparing it needs no runtime property/repository access.
authority_boundary: Matching serialized local_time is only a shortlist. Genuine owner/runtime registry identity, captured startup thread/mode and actual app/source checks must precede the selected runtime getter; original identity/digest/source equality and existing deterministic and locked producer validations remain necessary.
scope: Change local lookup/binding lines in bind_step_grounding only; do not move registration or mutate original/publication getters.
